# Fixtures for `midi` (Standard MIDI file)

Every file here was made for whiff's tests and is released under CC0-1.0. The music is a few
bars written for the tests; titles and names (Saltmere, Ana Lighthouse, Ben Gull, Mira Castell,
Saltmere Brass Band) are fictitious. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/scores.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `bell-patterns-type2-mido.mid` | mido 1.3.3: format 2, two patterns with their own tempos | CC0-1.0 |
| `harbour-bells-mido.mid` | mido 1.3.3: format 1, tempo map, time and key signatures, markers, a cue, programs, percussion, lyrics, GM on | CC0-1.0 |
| `harbour-bells-type0-mido.mid` | mido 1.3.3: the same merged into format 0 | CC0-1.0 |
| `harbour-wall-mido.kar` | mido 1.3.3: a karaoke file (`@` information lines, `/` and `\` breaks) | CC0-1.0 |
| `harbour-wall-music21.mid` | music21 9.9.1 (from the score of `harbour-wall-music21.musicxml`) | CC0-1.0 |
| `harbour-wall-verovio.mid` | verovio 6.3.0 (rendered from `harbour-wall-music21.musicxml`) | CC0-1.0 |
